"""Native-bound current-part unit-component branch for weld detail references."""
from modelcomponents import need_context,component_reference
from modelfeatures import unknown
from swarchive import ArchiveError

def verified_current_unit(a,component):
 root=getattr(a,'model_root_object',None)
 return (getattr(a,'model_root_verified',False) is True and getattr(a,'model_root_class',None)=='moPart_c' and isinstance(root,dict) and root.get('_class')=='moPart_c' and any(v is root for v in a.map) and component.get('_class')=='moUnitComponent_c' and component.get('has_external_model',1)==0 and component.get('owner') is root)

def component(a,schema=1):
 need_context(a);out=dict(component_reference=component_reference(a,schema));unit=out['component_reference']['component']
 if unit is not None and not verified_current_unit(a,unit):raise ArchiveError('unsupported weld component owner/model identity')
 out['detail_e8']=a.object('moDetailItem_c');out['detail_f8']=a.object('moDetailItem_c');unknown(a,out,'raw_100',a.i32)
 return out
